title: Uruguayan Wrap with Nutty Sprouts
description: A unique Italian-inspired wrap filled with sautéed Brussels sprouts and crunchy nuts, perfect for a quick snack.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
Sauté the Brussels sprouts until tender and slightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped nuts to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm the large flour tortilla in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the sautéed sprouts and nuts onto the tortilla.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to enclose.
Cut the wrap in half and serve immediately.
